focus: Final iteration: re-verify nine P1 findings at their cited path:line, record the repo-wide write-containment baseline as a cross-lane defect, and name the strongest finding per type.

label: Executor field name is split: the dispatch gate and payload read config.executor.type while the config template writes executor.kind and the runtime reader prefers kind. With the shipped template the branch selector resolves against an undefined field.
EXECUTOR_KINDS admits cli-deepseek-harness but the research YAML has six if_cli_ branches and no default, so a run configured with that kind dispatches nothing and surfaces no error.
One value has two token spellings: bare {generation} at the three dispatchId sites versus namespaced {config.lineage.generation} elsewhere in the same file; a single token map cannot bind both.

The lock note promises reclaim when the owning process is known dead, but isStaleLoopLock hard-codes ownerDead=false for a transient holder and the acquire step is exactly the owner-less call that produces one; a crashed run blocks the packet for up to 2x TTL.
if_cli_copilot is unreachable: no EXECUTOR_KINDS member can select it, so the branch is dead and falsely promises Copilot dispatch.

minIterations has no code owner: the floor is agent-executed YAML bookkeeping and the ledger schema marks deep_research.min_iterations_guard_pass as reserved with the reason that no workflow stages it.
branch-leases-waves has no runtime consumer: its only importers are type-only imports erased at runtime, so the module is dark and its vitest suite tests dead code.

The cli-classifier hub routes only Jev: hub-router.json registers two Jev-scoped vocabulary classes and ROUTER.md registers cli-jev as the sole mode, leaving a generic classification request with no class.

The write-containment baseline is repo-wide: snapshotOutOfScopeDirtyPaths reads git status over repoRoot and filters only by artifact containment, so a path a sibling lane writes after the snapshot is attributed to this lane and quarantined. Observed as cli-classifier.zip quarantined in the manifests of incumbent sibling research folders 001, 003 and 005 of the same parent packet.
Is the write-containment baseline per-lane or repo-wide?

The append gateway strips the fields the leaf contract requires: it accepted the iteration record (ok true, exit 0) and persisted only type, iteration, run, status, newInfoRatio, ruledOut and timestamp, dropping runId, sessionId, lineageId, answeredQuestions and graphEvents. No record in the whole state log carries a graphEvents key, so the loss is systemic rather than an artefact of this call. The delta file retains the full record, so the reducer loses nothing, but the two documented homes for graphEvents disagree.
